newsitem.title: ITALY: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday April 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Italy - Monday April 21.

text.p: The following are some of the top headlines in leading Italian newspapers.

* Italian president Oscar Luigi Scalfaro on a visit to Germany warned politicians working at the bicameral commission, aimed at carring out constitutional reforms, against persuing the harsh row with magistrates on the subject of justice system reforming, saying it could seriously endanger the future of reforms themselves (all).

* Deputy prime minister Walter Veltroni said concerning the reform of welfare state, it would be necessary to look for a compromise solution which could take into account both the Treasury and hard left Communist Refoundation's stand (all).
* Communist Refoundation president Armando Cossutta criticises foreign minister Lamberto Dini for his request of a definite timing to carry out welfare state reforms (La Repubblica).
* Trade unions' representative Sergio D'Antoni blamed the government for not making a clear stand over welfare state reforms, repeating pensions ought to be left untouched (La Repubblica).

* Preliminary figures for April consumer price index will today be published by six sample cities. Italian CPI is seen falling under two percent, paving the way for a possible official interest cut by the end of the month (all).
Reuters has not verified these stories and cannot vouch for their accuracy.
